theme_stances.key_argument: Capital intensity is growing alongside rising rates, regionalization, and a thirst for technology.
Enterprise AI is moving from cost-blind experimentation toward a balance of price and scarcity.
theme_stances.evidence: Perhaps we are moving towards a recognition of the spend and cost as a line item

theme_stances.key_argument: The incentive remains to spend more on AI, keeping the hardware trade in vogue.
theme_stances.evidence: incentive remains to spend more, not less

theme_stances.key_argument: The incentive remains to spend more on AI, keeping the hardware trade in vogue.
theme_stances.evidence: For now, however, the incentive remains to spend more, not less.

theme_stances.key_argument: AI capex investments remain elevated and show little signs of slowing into next year.
theme_stances.evidence: AI capex investments (i.e. capacity/infrastructure to facilitate the training & inferencing of AI workloads) remain elevated

theme_stances.key_argument: The best of the capex story is likely still ahead for semi precision equipment and China's AI supply chain.
theme_stances.evidence: Our house view remains constructive on the AI capex outlook

theme_stances.key_argument: The monetization narrative has flipped from revenue generation to compute scarcity, driving massive debt-financed capex.
theme_stances.evidence: The monetization narrative has flipped from 'can they generate enough revenue' to 'there isn't enough compute'

theme_stances.key_argument: Hyperscalers remain committed to heavy capital expenditure plans, which will drive further market gains.
theme_stances.evidence: First-quarter results confirmed that hyperscalers remain committed to their heavy capital expenditure plans.

theme_stances.key_argument: Fiscal expansion, geopolitical fragmentation, and AI infrastructure are driving a powerful, structural capex cycle.
theme_stances.evidence: companies exposed to this trend continue to trade in line with rising capex intensity.

theme_stances.key_argument: Global infrastructure and supply chain investment
theme_stances.evidence: Global infrastructure and supply chain investment

tension_points.bull_case: Secular backdrop remains strong, capex expectations are robust, and earnings revisions are moving higher.
tension_points.bear_case: Market structure is becoming fragile due to high leverage and expanding volatility in large-cap tech.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Hyperscaler price action signaling a strategic pivot away from AI investment.
